stem: An incoming plant looks healthy, but site procedure requires quarantine on arrival. What should the technician do?
choices: Follow the quarantine procedure until the authorized release criteria are met
Skip quarantine because no symptoms are visible
Place it directly with mother plants for closer observation
Ask another technician to decide informally
rationale: Visible health does not establish freedom from pests or pathogens. Quarantine is a controlled status released through the defined process.
